events.verdict: Haliburton (IND) creates the marginal contact with Coulibaly (WAS) by extending his leg during the jump shot attempt.
Coulibaly (WAS) and Siakam (IND) come together in pursuit of the loose ball and the contact is incidental.
Siakam (IND) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Siakam (IND briefly has an arm extended across Poole's (WAS) body, which Poole accentuates by lifting his own arm upwards. The contact between the two players is marginal.
Nembhard (IND) places his off-arm against Poole's (WAS) side and releases as he comes to a stop.
Nembhard (IND) and Poole (WAS) briefly engage and disengage.
Kispert (WAS) initiates contact with Nembhard's (IND) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Nembhard (IND) grabs Poole's (WAS) arm on the perimeter.
Nembhard (IND) legally contests Poole's (WAS) jump shot attempt.
Sarr (WAS) maintains a legal guarding position during Mathurin's (IND) drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Nembhard (IND) maintains a legal guarding position during Poole's (WAS) drive to the basket and shot attempt and the contact is incidental.
Siakam (IND) makes contact with the ball to block the shot attempt by Coulibaly (WAS) and the contact to the body is marginal.
Toppin (IND) extends an arm into Coulibaly (WAS), causing him to lose his balance.
Mathurin (IND) gathers the ball and takes three steps.
Nembhard (IND) moves into and makes contact with Poole (WAS) that affects his SQBR.
Coulibaly (WAS) initiates illegal contact with Siakam (IND) as he attempts to get to the pass in the post.
Coulibaly (WAS) commits a take foul on Siakam (IND).
Nembhard (IND) moves alongside Poole's (WAS) path and marginal body contact occurs during the driving shot attempt.
Sarr (WAS) commits a take foul on Siakam (IND).
